results.title: Warning period over as speed cameras go live along final stretch of Rt. 13 in Southwest Philadelphia
results.description: Ticketing is now live for the speed cameras along the final stretch of Route 13, which cuts through the city from Northeast Philadelphia to West Philadelphia.
